metadata.description: Agent skills, custom agents, rules, hooks and orchestration packs for testing and quality engineering, for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

plugins.name: qa-core
plugins.description: Test design, planning, exploratory testing, requirements traceability and bug reporting.

plugins.name: test-automation
plugins.description: Unit tests, TDD, Playwright, mocking, visual regression, migration and test code review.

plugins.name: api-testing
plugins.description: API test automation with Playwright and contract testing.

plugins.name: non-functional-testing
plugins.description: Accessibility, performance and load, and application security testing.

plugins.name: ai-quality
plugins.description: Testing LLM features, guardrails, groundedness and agent skills.

plugins.name: quality-gates
plugins.description: Quality contracts, change gates, waivers, release readiness, metrics and debt.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.description: Creating skills, custom agents, commands and prompt files, instructions and rules, hooks, plugins and orchestration packs for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, plus auditing a whole collection. Each covers this repository's single-source format and your own project's native files.

plugins.name: orchestration-basics
plugins.description: A minimal orchestrator with three read-mostly helpers (planner, explorer, analyst) that shows how to split analysis and planning across subagents to save context, with stop gates for the user. Start here to learn the pattern; it does not implement code. For a pipeline that also implements, reviews and commits, use plan-explore-review-commit.

plugins.name: plan-explore-review-commit
plugins.description: A full delivery pipeline: a planner and an orchestrator drive architect, researcher, explorer, implementer, QA strategy, security, code review and docs subagents through small test-first phases, with a review and a user-approved commit after each. Pick it for multi-phase feature or refactoring work; for analysis and planning only, use orchestration-basics.

plugins.name: ui-api-automation
plugins.description: Explores an application (frontend through Playwright MCP, backend through its OpenAPI spec), plans coverage, implements UI and API tests, reviews them and runs them to a verified result. Pick it for a full suite with a review and verification stage; for a small first batch of tests, or a project that still needs a test framework set up, use ui-api-automation-minimal.

plugins.name: ui-api-automation-minimal
plugins.description: A compact UI + API pack with four helpers: explore (OpenAPI and/or Playwright MCP), plan, set up a test framework if none exists, and implement tests, each returning the same handoff packet. Pick it for a small first batch of tests or a project without a test framework; for a full suite with review and verification stages, use ui-api-automation.

plugins.name: always-on-skills
plugins.description: Keeps always-apply skill invariants, such as unslop-tests, in force for the whole session, and restates the relevant one after each edit to a file in its scope.

plugins.name: print-tool-info
plugins.description: Shows the tool name, arguments, time and working directory before each tool call. Useful for learning how hooks work and for debugging what an agent does.
